hook.description: Juliana's blood-streaked hand uncurls to reveal an emerald ring amidst sharp thorns.
hook.evidence: The visceral imagery of blood and sharp thorns immediately establishes high stakes and mystery.

proposal.reason: This sequence captures the entire rescue arc, from the discovery of the ring to the emotional reunion and the promise of protection.

hook.description: Alexander kneeling before Juliana, washing her bloodied hands by the fire.
hook.evidence: The intimate, tender contrast between the violence of her wounds and his gentle care creates an immediate emotional hook.

proposal.reason: This focuses on the romantic tension and the shift from rescue to the vow of vengeance, ending on a powerful, ominous note.
